entities.name: Julien Andavo Mbia
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Julien Andavo Mbia was a Congolese Roman Catholic prelate. He was bishop of Isiro–Niangara from 2003 until his death. Mbia died on 14 July 2024 in Durba, Haut-Uélé, at the age of 73.
